title: The bottom-extension coefficient quotient is Z modulo ell to n
statement: For finite-field datum D, prime ell different from D.p and n≥1, the ring of finiteGeneralRingPrimeSetting D ell hEll n hn admits a unital ring equivalence with ULift(ZMod(ell^n)).

proof.text: Identify the bottom intermediate extension with Q_ell. The spectral norm extension theorem identifies its ring of integers with Z_ell. Its DVR maximal ideal transports to the maximal ideal generated by ell. Thus the nth power of the chosen uniformizer ideal transports to (ell^n), independently of the uniformizer choice. Descend the ring equivalence to the quotient and apply the kernel and surjectivity theorem for PadicInt.toZModPow. Finish with the ULift ring equivalence.

theorem primeQuotientEquiv
    (D : WeilConjectures.FiniteFieldDatum.{u})
    (ell : ℕ) [Fact ell.Prime] (hEll : ell ≠ D.p) (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    Nonempty ((finiteGeneralRingPrimeSetting D ell hEll n hn).Ring ≃+*
      ULift.{u} (ZMod (ell ^ n)))
